# Steamboat Pilot & Today

> Free daily newspaper serving Routt County, Colorado with local news, community features, and essential resources for Steamboat Springs residents.

Steamboat Pilot & Today is the primary news source for the Yampa Valley region, covering local government, community events, and regional updates. The site has extensive coverage of COVID-19 pandemic impacts and recovery resources for the Steamboat Springs area.

## Key Topics

- Steamboat Springs
- Routt County
- COVID-19 pandemic
- Colorado news
- Local news
- Community events
- Government
- Case tracking
- Pandemic statistics
- Homeschool Heroes
- Public notices
- Weather alerts
- Regional updates
- Crisis support
- Yampa Valley

## Core & Homepage

- [News | SteamboatToday.com](https://www.steamboatpilot.com): Homepage for Steamboat Pilot & Today, free daily newspaper serving Routt County, Colorado.

## COVID-19 Coverage & Resources

- [Local crisis support, food, housing, transportation and utility resources](https://www.steamboatpilot.com/news/local-crisis-support-food-housing-transportation-and-utility-resources-for-those-impacted-by-covid-19): Crisis support and resource guide for COVID-19 impacted residents in Steamboat Springs area.
- [How many people have tested positive for COVID-19 in Routt County?](https://www.steamboatpilot.com/news/how-many-people-have-tested-positive-for-covid-19-in-routt-county): COVID-19 case tracking and pandemic statistics for Routt County and Steamboat Springs.
- [Video Gallery: COVID-19 local panels | SteamboatToday.com](https://www.steamboatpilot.com/news/video-gallery-covid-19-local-panels): Video gallery of COVID-19 expert panels with Steamboat Springs city officials and community leaders.

## Community Features & Stories

- [How the Yampa Valley finds the #silverlining in the time of COVID-19](https://www.steamboatpilot.com/coronavirus/how-the-yampa-valley-finds-the-silverlining-in-the-time-of-covid-19): Community stories of kindness and silver linings in Yampa Valley during COVID-19 pandemic.
- [Homeschool Heroes | SteamboatToday.com](https://www.steamboatpilot.com/homeschoolheroes): Community feature program highlighting homeschooling success stories during COVID-19 pandemic.

## Optional & Entertainment

- [Bored? Color these creations from local creatives](https://www.steamboatpilot.com/explore-steamboat/bored-color-these-creations-from-local-creatives): Community coloring pages from local Steamboat artists for family entertainment.
